title: Weather & Water Reservoir Station
tagline: Environmental science lab! Monitor rainfall, water depth, temp, and trigger automated floodgates.

phases.instructions: Collect the DHT11 temp/humidity sensor, FC-37 rain sensor module, Water Level depth sensor, 1602 LCD, and SG90 servo floodgate.
verificationCheckpoints: DHT11 blue digital temperature/humidity sensor ready
FC-37 nickel-plated rain sensor board ready
Submersible water depth sensor plate ready

phases.instructions: Wire DHT11 to Pin 2, Rain Sensor Analog to A1, Water Depth Sensor to A2, Servo to Pin 9, and LCD to A4/A5.
verificationCheckpoints: Rain sensor in A1, Water depth in A2
DHT11 data line has 10k pull-up resistor or onboard module resistor

phases.instructions: WATER SAFETY CHECK: Only the sensing traces of the water probe may touch water. Never submerge the Arduino board, breadboard, or servo motor in liquid!
verificationCheckpoints: Breadboard and Arduino kept on dry towel
Water cup kept separate from electronics

phases.instructions: Review how the Arduino monitors rain presence and reservoir depth, triggering emergency floodgate evacuation if critical depth is reached.
phases.codeExplanation:
- FC-37 resistance drops when water droplets bridge the nickel tracks (rainVal < 600 indicates rain).
- Water level probe acts as variable resistor immersed in water (higher water = higher analog reading).
- When waterLevel exceeds FLOOD_LIMIT (450), the servo gate swings 90 degrees to release water.
verificationCheckpoints: Understand how water conductivity decreases electrical resistance

phases.instructions: Upload sketch. Dip water probe into a shallow cup of water. When depth exceeds threshold, verify servo floodgate swings open!
verificationCheckpoints: Dipping probe past threshold opens floodgate servo

phases.instructions: Reservoir protected! You built an automated environmental civil engineering defense station.
verificationCheckpoints: Ready to claim Earth Scientist badge

variants.title: Reservoir Auto-Fill Sump
variants.description: Use the water level sensor to control an inlet relay solenoid rather than a drain pump.
variants.wiringDifferences: Connect relay module to Pin 7 to drive 12V pump solenoid
variants.codeAdaptation: Invert logic: energize relay when water < 300, de-energize when water > 700

extensionMissions.title: Electrolysis Protection Pulse
extensionMissions.objective: Prevent probe corrosion by only supplying power to the water sensor trace for 10ms right before analogRead().
hints: Power sensor VCC from digital pin 6 instead of 5V rail
digitalWrite(6, HIGH); delay(10); analogRead(A0); digitalWrite(6, LOW);

story: Build an Automated Environmental & Floodgate Station! Monitor environmental conditions with DHT11 temperature/humidity, FC-37 raindrop plate, and water level depth sensor. If rainfall exceeds capacity, an emergency servo floodgate opens automatically.

troubleshooting.symptom: Water level reading is erratic or fluctuating wildly
troubleshooting.cause: Sensing traces have corrosion or static pickup
troubleshooting.solution: Dry probe with paper towel, and connect probe GND directly to Arduino main ground pin.
diagnosticSteps: Wipe trace electrodes dry with paper towel.
Verify analog pin A0 wire has good breadboard grip.
